1. Add a subscription link, scan a QR code, or import a configuration file.

2. Select a node, then tap Connect. Approve the Android VPN prompt when requested.

3. A started VPN does not guarantee internet access. Use the connection test to verify access.

4. Manage subscriptions in Groups. Configure per-app routing and DNS in Settings.
Enter a JSON object. Leave empty to use the default configuration.
Align a node or subscription QR code within the frame. You can also choose an image.
Connection changes take effect the next time the VPN starts.
Only in VPN mode: exclude local network traffic from the VPN. Core routing still applies to traffic entering through proxy ports.
Send local traffic received by the core directly. With VPN LAN bypass on, this mainly covers traffic from proxy ports.
